status_note: The three targeted projections (E1 illegal iblock op with verbatim LowlevelError from resolveIblockRead condexe.cc:261, E2 dominator-chain throw from getReplacementRead condexe.cc:303, E3 verify failure with untouched Funcdata) are byte-identical MATCH over 6 records including the pinned partial state at each abort point, but execute/doReplacement success legs and the removeFromFlowSplit error boundary remain UNTESTED under CFG-0001, so the fixture-level B2 status is UNTESTED.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: resolveIblockRead/getReplacementRead/resolveRead/getMultiequalRead/pullbackOp/getNewMulti return the replacement Varnode or throw LowlevelError (condexe.cc:261/303 verbatim messages); doReplacement (cc:320-357) mutates fd in place (opUnsetInput cc:333, opSetInput cc:352, RETURN-copy insertion cc:339-349) and has no out-param; execute (cc:457-476) returns void in the oracle but its two throw sources abort apply; ActionConditionalExe::apply (cc:478-503) returns int4 0 normally and never returns on throw (the exception unwinds the whole action pipeline, Funcdata keeps partial state). The Rust port mirrors this as Result: Err(Error::Lowlevel) from execute() propagates through apply() via ?, ActionGroup aborts on it (action.rs), partial fd mutations persist.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: doReplacement re-reads vn->beginDescend() after every iteration (cc:355) and each iteration removes exactly one descendant (progress invariant); execute destroys iblock ops in REVERSE list order (cc:464-474, endOp-1 down to beginOp), calling doReplacement only for non-branch ops, so at the E1/E2 abort the trailing CBRANCH is already destroyed while the failing COPY survives; verify() tests removability of every op except the trailing cbranch (cc:418-426); apply's do-while round loop over bblocks (cc:490-500) never restarts because the throw unwinds it; getReplacementRead's dominator walk is while(curbl->getImmedDom() != iblock) with the null check AFTER the advance (cc:300-304), exercised by E2's reader->init->entry two-step chain.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: ActionConditionalExe::apply accumulates numhits per successful execute (cc:496) and adds to Action::count only AFTER the loop completes (cc:501) — a throw skips both, so no counter state is pinned at the abort points; doReplacement clears replacement/pullback maps once per op (cc:323-324) and refills them per descendant walk; PcodeOpBank uniqid (SeqNum time) increments per newOp in fixture construction order and is NOT consumed by the abort paths (no new op is created before either throw), which the per-block op-count projections pin.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The descendant iteration order (std::list beginDescend vs Rugra descend_iter Vec order) is order-insensitive here because each error case has exactly one descendant on the failing op's output; the dominator walk compares FlowBlock pointer identity (curbl->getImmedDom() != iblock, cc:300) mapped to Arc::ptr_eq; the slot search getSlot(vn) (op.hh:166, first matching input slot) maps to the linear find over num_input; block identification in projections is creation ordinal (bN), identical on both sides.

overlays.policy: primary file under test; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base copy

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus one hash-verified source overlay; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: Three synthetic Funcdata objects (E1/E2/E3), each a 7-block diamond: b0 init [COPY bool, CBRANCH bool] -> b1/b2 -> b3 iblock [COPY vnY<-vnW, CBRANCH] -> b4 posta [COPY reader vnY] / b5 postb; b6 floats and writes vnW outside the iblock with a non-MULTIEQUAL COPY (passes testOpRead cc:126-139, illegal for resolveIblockRead cc:261). Heritage::buildInfoList precondition replicated per Funcdata (buildHeritageArray reads numHeritagePasses, condexe.cc:23-37). E3's iblock CBRANCH reads an uncorrelated constant instead of the shared boolean so verifySameCondition fails (cc:88-89).
analysis_options.case_matrix: E1: b4 immed_dom=b3 (reader dominated by iblock) -> resolve chain reaches resolveIblockRead and throws the illegal-op LowlevelError; E2: b4 immed_dom=b0 (dominated by init, walk advances once then leaves the graph at the entry) -> throws the no-dominator LowlevelError; E3: uncorrelated booleans -> trial false, apply returns 0, zero mutation
analysis_options.error_injection: E1/E2 inject unresolvable reader data-flow shapes (not runtime fault injection); E3 injects a verify-failure shape
analysis_options.normalization: Only block creation ordinals (bN) replace raw pointers; error messages, op inventories, op counts, in/out edge counts and descendant counts are byte-compared

observation_schema.format: 6 fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.error_projection: For E1/E2: kind (lowlevel) and the verbatim LowlevelError message caught out of ActionConditionalExe::apply; for E3: apply's return code with no exception. kind=lowlevel is only emitted for Error::Lowlevel on the Rust side so a Rugra-internal error would surface as a projection difference.
observation_schema.state_projection: Per case after apply: total block count, per-block op-count inventory (bN:count), the iblock's remaining opcode list, its in/out edge counts (still 2/2: removeFromFlowSplit never ran), and the failing COPY output's remaining descendant count
observation_schema.preserved: No message text, op count, opcode name, edge count or descendant count is normalized; only raw pointers are replaced by creation ordinals

build.oracle_archive: Exact locked Ghidra commit archive and locked Makefile libdecomp.a
build.access_leverage: #define private public + #define class struct (immed_dom wiring and block op-list reads; apply itself is public at action.hh:130)
build.rust_build: Cargo --locked --offline in isolated target, then rustc with the librugra_sleigh native link

error_illegal_iblock_op.covers: E1: apply aborts with the verbatim LowlevelError('Conditional execution: Illegal op in iblock') (condexe.cc:261) — the COPY-in-iblock fall-through leg (cc:245-255 -> 261) where input 0 is written by a non-iblock-MULTIEQUAL op; pinned partial state: CBRANCH destroyed, failing COPY alive, reader untouched, iblock still 2-in/2-out in the graph; doubles as the doReplacement death-loop regression (pre-fix Rugra loops forever on this exact input — negative control: timeout 124)

error_missing_dominator.covers: E2: apply aborts with the verbatim LowlevelError('Conditional execution: Could not find dominator') (condexe.cc:303) — the dominator walk advances once (reader->init) then leaves the graph at the entry (cc:300-304), exercising both the loop-advance leg and the throw; same partial-state shape as E1

verify_failure_no_change.covers: E3: uncorrelated iblock CBRANCH boolean -> verifySameCondition false (cc:88-89) -> trial false -> apply returns 0 with NO exception and a fully untouched Funcdata (COPY+CBRANCH still in the iblock, all op counts unchanged)

execute_flow_split_boundary.covers: execute's removeFromFlowSplit error boundary (condexe.rs maps the callee Err into Error::Lowlevel instead of discarding it; oracle throw 'Can only split the flow for an empty block' funcdata_block.cc:884-885) is NOT exercised: E1/E2 abort before the flow split and E3 never executes. The doReplacement success legs (op_set_input progress, getNewMulti, RETURN-copy cc:339-349) are likewise not projected here.

branches.detail: The remove_from_flow_split call boundary in execute now propagates Err (map_err(Error::Lowlevel)) instead of discarding it, but the callee funcdata.rs still returns Rugra-side message text ('remove_from_flow_split: block must be empty' != oracle 'Can only split the flow for an empty block') and the pre-fix swap mapping (gap doc defect F: inverted mapping, one branch out-of-bounds) — any success-path fixture through execute() needs CFG-0001's corrected removeFromFlowSplit first, and the doReplacement RETURN leg (cc:339-349 partial state with the inputless COPY) should be covered by the same follow-up.
